function: above_phy: the agent only chooses each user's serving beam, a handover and user association decision; transmit power is fixed, and no beam or resource control is learned (pp. 3-4).
notes: Exclude, above_phy (Step 1, code 4). p. 1: "we design a beam handover strategy" for multi-beam LEO satellites. p. 3 defines the action as the access vector u(i,l,v): "We use the access vector to represent the action", i.e. which beam a user connects to, so the learned decision is handover and user association. p. 4, Table I fixes the transmit power at 2 W. p. 5 says MODQN also suits terrestrial handover. No power, resource or beam-control decision is learned, so area 6 does not apply; the reviewer may confirm this reading of beam handover.
